title: Meta-Analysis Extraction Output
description: Schema for structured data extracted from a single research paper for meta-analysis

paper_id.description: Unique identifier for the paper (e.g., 'Smith_2020' or filename stem)

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier, or null if not found

config_used.description: Name of the config file used for extraction

notes.description: Free-text notes about the extraction (e.g., data quality issues, ambiguities)

treatment_mean.description: Mean value under intervention/treatment condition. Null if not reported.

control_mean.description: Mean value under control/comparison condition. Null if not reported.

effect_pct.description: Percent change: (treatment - control) / |control| * 100. Null if control is 0 or means are missing.

n.description: Sample size per group (replicates). Null if not found in paper.

variance_type.description: Type of variance/dispersion measure reported. Null if no variance found.

variance_value.description: Numeric variance value. For CI_95, report half-width. Null if not reported.

variance_treatment.description: Variance value for treatment group specifically, if reported separately. Null otherwise.

variance_control.description: Variance value for control group specifically, if reported separately. Null otherwise.

data_source.description: Where the data was found (e.g., 'Table 2', 'Figure 3', 'text p.5')

treatment_description.description: Description of the treatment condition (e.g., 'Elevated CO2 600 ppm')

control_description.description: Description of the control condition (e.g., 'Ambient CO2 400 ppm')

p_value.description: Reported p-value for the comparison, if available. Can be numeric (0.03) or string ('<0.001').
